dict.string: Saywell can pause Music or Spotify while you dictate and resume them afterwards. Only if you turn on Pause Music While Dictating.
Saywell can add names from your contacts to its dictionary so it spells them correctly. Only when you click Import Contacts.
Saywell records what your Mac plays only while you record a call, to write its transcript and notes on this Mac.
Saywell listens to your voice to turn speech into text.
Saywell transcribes your speech on-device to type it for you.
